chunks.title: Data Protection and Retention Policy
chunks.text: Customer personal data such as names, phone numbers, email addresses, PAN and card details must only be stored in approved systems. Personal data must never be pasted into public AI tools or shared over personal email.
chunks.index_text: Data Protection and Retention Policy Personal data handling Customer personal data such as names, phone numbers, email addresses, PAN and card details must only be stored in approved systems. Personal data must never be pasted into public AI tools or shared over personal email.

chunks.title: Data Protection and Retention Policy
chunks.text: Customer support transcripts are retained for 2 years. Financial records, invoices and expense claims are retained for 8 years to meet statutory audit requirements. Recruitment data of unsuccessful candidates is deleted after 12 months.
chunks.index_text: Data Protection and Retention Policy Retention periods Customer support transcripts are retained for 2 years. Financial records, invoices and expense claims are retained for 8 years to meet statutory audit requirements. Recruitment data of unsuccessful candidates is deleted after 12 months.

chunks.title: Data Protection and Retention Policy
chunks.text: Requests from customers to access or delete their data must be logged with the privacy team within 1 business day and completed within 30 days.
chunks.index_text: Data Protection and Retention Policy Data subject requests Requests from customers to access or delete their data must be logged with the privacy team within 1 business day and completed within 30 days.

chunks.title: Data Protection and Retention Policy
chunks.text: Any suspected data breach must be reported to the security team within 2 hours of discovery. The security team assesses whether regulators and affected customers must be notified.
chunks.index_text: Data Protection and Retention Policy Incident reporting Any suspected data breach must be reported to the security team within 2 hours of discovery. The security team assesses whether regulators and affected customers must be notified.

chunks.title: Travel and Expense Policy
chunks.text: Employees may claim reimbursement for business travel, client meals, conference fees and approved software subscriptions. Personal entertainment, fines and alcohol without a client present are not reimbursable.
chunks.index_text: Travel and Expense Policy Eligible expenses Employees may claim reimbursement for business travel, client meals, conference fees and approved software subscriptions. Personal entertainment, fines and alcohol without a client present are not reimbursable.

chunks.title: Travel and Expense Policy
chunks.text: Expense claims must be submitted in the finance portal within 30 days of the expense date. Claims older than 60 days are rejected unless the employee's director approves a late-submission exception.
chunks.index_text: Travel and Expense Policy Claim deadlines Expense claims must be submitted in the finance portal within 30 days of the expense date. Claims older than 60 days are rejected unless the employee's director approves a late-submission exception.

chunks.title: Travel and Expense Policy
chunks.text: An itemised receipt is mandatory for every expense above INR 500. Hotel stays are capped at INR 9,000 per night in metro cities and INR 6,000 per night elsewhere. Client meals are capped at INR 2,500 per attendee.
chunks.index_text: Travel and Expense Policy Receipts and limits An itemised receipt is mandatory for every expense above INR 500. Hotel stays are capped at INR 9,000 per night in metro cities and INR 6,000 per night elsewhere. Client meals are capped at INR 2,500 per attendee.

chunks.title: Travel and Expense Policy
chunks.text: Claims up to INR 25,000 are approved by the line manager. Claims above INR 25,000 also need finance controller approval. Approved claims are paid with the next payroll cycle, usually within 10 business days.
chunks.index_text: Travel and Expense Policy Approval and payment Claims up to INR 25,000 are approved by the line manager. Claims above INR 25,000 also need finance controller approval. Approved claims are paid with the next payroll cycle, usually within 10 business days.

chunks.title: IT Access and Device Policy
chunks.text: Access to business applications is requested through the IT service desk using the Access Request form. The request must name the application, the role needed and a business justification. The line manager approves the request before IT provisions it.
chunks.index_text: IT Access and Device Policy Requesting system access Access to business applications is requested through the IT service desk using the Access Request form. The request must name the application, the role needed and a business justification. The line manager approves the request before IT provisions it.

chunks.title: IT Access and Device Policy
chunks.text: Standard access requests are fulfilled within 2 business days. Access to production databases or finance systems requires an additional security review and takes up to 5 business days.
chunks.index_text: IT Access and Device Policy Provisioning timelines Standard access requests are fulfilled within 2 business days. Access to production databases or finance systems requires an additional security review and takes up to 5 business days.

chunks.title: IT Access and Device Policy
chunks.text: Locked accounts can be unlocked through the self-service password portal after multi-factor verification. If self-service fails, the service desk resets the password after verifying the employee's identity by video call.
chunks.index_text: IT Access and Device Policy Password resets and lockouts Locked accounts can be unlocked through the self-service password portal after multi-factor verification. If self-service fails, the service desk resets the password after verifying the employee's identity by video call.

chunks.title: IT Access and Device Policy
chunks.text: New joiners receive a standard laptop on day one. Replacement laptops are issued when a device is older than 4 years or is damaged; damage must be reported within 48 hours. Lost devices must be reported to security immediately so the device can be remotely wiped.

chunks.title: Leave and Attendance Policy
chunks.text: Full-time employees accrue 18 days of paid annual leave per year. Up to 10 unused days can be carried forward to the next calendar year. Leave must be applied for in the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance.
chunks.index_text: Leave and Attendance Policy Annual leave Full-time employees accrue 18 days of paid annual leave per year. Up to 10 unused days can be carried forward to the next calendar year. Leave must be applied for in the HR portal at least 5 working days in advance.

chunks.title: Leave and Attendance Policy
chunks.text: Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days.
chunks.index_text: Leave and Attendance Policy Sick leave Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days.

chunks.title: Leave and Attendance Policy
chunks.text: Birthing parents receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave. Non-birthing parents receive 4 weeks of paid parental leave, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth or adoption.
chunks.index_text: Leave and Attendance Policy Parental leave Birthing parents receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave. Non-birthing parents receive 4 weeks of paid parental leave, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth or adoption.

chunks.title: Leave and Attendance Policy
chunks.text: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Fully remote arrangements need HR approval and a signed remote work agreement.
chunks.index_text: Leave and Attendance Policy Remote work Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Fully remote arrangements need HR approval and a signed remote work agreement.

chunks.title: Procurement and Vendor Policy
chunks.text: Any purchase above INR 50,000 needs a purchase requisition in the procurement system before a vendor is engaged. Purchases below INR 50,000 can use a corporate card with a receipt.
chunks.index_text: Procurement and Vendor Policy Purchase requisitions Any purchase above INR 50,000 needs a purchase requisition in the procurement system before a vendor is engaged. Purchases below INR 50,000 can use a corporate card with a receipt.

chunks.title: Procurement and Vendor Policy
chunks.text: Purchases between INR 50,000 and INR 10,00,000 need at least two competing quotations. Purchases above INR 10,00,000 need three quotations and approval from the procurement committee.
chunks.index_text: Procurement and Vendor Policy Quotations Purchases between INR 50,000 and INR 10,00,000 need at least two competing quotations. Purchases above INR 10,00,000 need three quotations and approval from the procurement committee.

chunks.title: Procurement and Vendor Policy
chunks.text: New vendors must submit a GST certificate, PAN, cancelled cheque and signed code of conduct. Vendor master data is verified by finance before the first purchase order is issued. Onboarding normally takes 5 business days.
chunks.index_text: Procurement and Vendor Policy Vendor onboarding New vendors must submit a GST certificate, PAN, cancelled cheque and signed code of conduct. Vendor master data is verified by finance before the first purchase order is issued. Onboarding normally takes 5 business days.

chunks.title: Procurement and Vendor Policy
chunks.text: Vendor invoices must quote a valid purchase order number. Standard payment terms are 45 days from invoice receipt. Invoices without a matching purchase order and goods receipt are put on hold.
chunks.index_text: Procurement and Vendor Policy Invoices and payment terms Vendor invoices must quote a valid purchase order number. Standard payment terms are 45 days from invoice receipt. Invoices without a matching purchase order and goods receipt are put on hold.

chunks.title: Customer Refund Standard Operating Procedure
chunks.text: Customers can request a full refund within 14 days of purchase if the subscription has not been used for more than 5 sessions. After 14 days, refunds are prorated for the unused months of an annual plan.
chunks.index_text: Customer Refund Standard Operating Procedure Refund eligibility Customers can request a full refund within 14 days of purchase if the subscription has not been used for more than 5 sessions. After 14 days, refunds are prorated for the unused months of an annual plan.

chunks.title: Customer Refund Standard Operating Procedure
chunks.text: The support agent verifies the order ID, checks usage in the billing console, and raises a refund ticket. Refunds up to INR 20,000 are approved by the support lead. Larger refunds need approval from the finance team.
chunks.index_text: Customer Refund Standard Operating Procedure Processing steps The support agent verifies the order ID, checks usage in the billing console, and raises a refund ticket. Refunds up to INR 20,000 are approved by the support lead. Larger refunds need approval from the finance team.

chunks.title: Customer Refund Standard Operating Procedure
chunks.text: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 7 business days. Card refunds may take an additional 3 to 5 days to appear on the customer's statement.
chunks.index_text: Customer Refund Standard Operating Procedure Timelines Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 7 business days. Card refunds may take an additional 3 to 5 days to appear on the customer's statement.

chunks.title: Customer Refund Standard Operating Procedure
chunks.text: If a customer has raised a chargeback with their bank, the refund ticket must be paused and escalated to the payments risk team. Agents must not promise a refund while a dispute is open.
